name: Finance & Profit
focus: Break-even CAC, ROAS, contribution margin and profitability
summary: Kit Muda Cero is WATCH leaning GO at 39.90 EUR. Exact margin is pending because reusable roller landed cost, shipping, payment/platform fees and return reserve are not verified. 29.90 EUR is too tight for a 50% pre-ad contribution target unless sourcing improves materially.
blocker: Need verified full-kit non-ad variable costs: reusable roller EU landed cost/SLA, shipping, fees and return reserve.

tax_basis.mainland_spain_hypothesis: Retail modeled VAT-inclusive at 21%; revenue ex-VAT = retail/1.21.
tax_basis.canary_note: Canary sales require separate IGIC/import treatment and are excluded from this cycle.

verified_inputs.reusable_roller: WATCH listing 6.73 USD; EU fulfillment and EUR landed cost unverified

thresholds.GO: pre-ad contribution margin >=50% of ex-VAT revenue
thresholds.NO_GO: <40% unless a non-paid acquisition case justifies an exception

price_models.decision: WATCH / likely reject as primary paid-traffic price

scenario_ranges.explanation: Unknown costs are not estimated. Instead, 40/50/60% pre-ad contribution targets define allowable total non-ad variable-cost ceilings.

sensitivity: Each additional 1 EUR of variable cost reduces break-even CAC by 1 EUR.
At 39.90 EUR, each extra 1 EUR variable cost reduces contribution margin by about 3.0 percentage points of ex-VAT revenue.
At 34.90 EUR, each extra 1 EUR reduces it by about 3.5 points.
At 29.90 EUR, each extra 1 EUR reduces it by about 4.0 points.

candidate_decisions.gate: Verify total non-ad variable costs <=16.49 EUR/order to clear 50% contribution target.
